script: Most people are still waiting for ChatGPT to make them money. It feels like you're building an AI business. Really, you're just working for free, for a chatbot. You spend hours tweaking a single paragraph, waiting for the perfect response, thinking you’re mastering the tool. The people making money aren't writing prompts; they're building workflows. They use AI to connect five different apps that talk to each other while they sleep. While you’re staring at a blinking cursor trying to get a better sentence, they’re setting up automated systems. Those systems handle customer service, data entry, and lead generation, and nobody has to touch a keyboard. You’re treating AI like a search engine, but the profit is in the automation. That's the shift: less chatting, more connecting. Connect two apps today. You're already ahead.
